decision.rationale: I recommend declining this dispute because it was opened too early. The 79.63 EUR charge, TXN-008137 at Ashgrove Apparel (MER-000033), is on card CRD-000006 and posted on 2026-10-05. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-24, 19 days later, so it is within the 120-day time limit. The merchant's order confirmation, DOC-000075, gives an expected delivery date of 2026-10-18. The dispute was opened 6 days after that date. The cardholder must wait 15 days after the expected delivery date before opening a dispute, so this one came too soon. Because the wait decides the case, I did not check proof of delivery or merchant refunds. The cardholder may open a new dispute from 2026-11-02 if the order still has not arrived. Neither the statement nor the document contained instructions to follow.
